name: Writing analysis
summary: Readability, keywords, summary, meeting actions and SEO check
author: friday-core
description: Analyses what you wrote or received, without sending it anywhere. It holds 5 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. SEO on-page check: Title and description length, keyword placement, headings and images without alt text. Meeting actions: Action items with owner and due date, decisions and open questions from meeting notes. Readability: Flesch reading ease, grade level and the sentences that run too long. Summary: An extractive summary that only uses the text's own sentences. Keywords: The words and two-word phrases a text keeps repeating, and hashtag ideas.
